name: power-saver
description: One switch for your PC's power: `/power-saver on` for unattended work (builds, tests, AI agents: CPU boost off, each NVIDIA GPU at a share of its default power limit, screens dark, Windows Energy Saver on), `/power-saver off` for full power when you're at the PC. Windows; any CPU; NVIDIA GPUs (AMD and Intel GPUs are detected and skipped). Never touches network adapters.
